# RepoLens

> RepoLens writes architecture documentation from a repository: modules, API surface, routes, dependency graph, code health, and pull request diffs. Deterministic by default. No API key required.

RepoLens is the npm package `@chappibunny/repolens` (Node.js 18+). It is a CLI, a stdio MCP server, and a composite GitHub Action. Use it when a person or an assistant needs an architecture map of a codebase, a code-health badge, or a pull request comment that describes what changed. It does not replace the project's own product docs, and it does not require an OpenAI key to run.

## Install

- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chappibunny/repolens): `npx @chappibunny/repolens demo`
- [GitHub](https://github.com/CHAPIBUNNY/repolens): source, issues, and the composite action
- [Gallery](https://chapibunny.github.io/repolens/): architecture pages for public repositories
- [MCP install notes](https://github.com/CHAPIBUNNY/repolens/blob/main/llms-install.md): copy-paste steps for coding agents

## CLI

- [demo](https://github.com/CHAPIBUNNY/repolens/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md): `npx @chappibunny/repolens demo` writes local docs with no API keys
- [publish](https://github.com/CHAPIBUNNY/repolens/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md): `npx @chappibunny/repolens publish` scans and publishes
- [badge](https://github.com/CHAPIBUNNY/repolens/blob/main/README.md): `npx @chappibunny/repolens badge` prints shields.io code-health JSON, SVG, or markdown
- [comment](https://github.com/CHAPIBUNNY/repolens/blob/main/README.md): `npx @chappibunny/repolens comment --base <ref> --head <ref>` prints an architecture diff
- [app](https://github.com/CHAPIBUNNY/repolens/blob/main/docs/GITHUB_APP.md): `npx @chappibunny/repolens app` self-hosts the GitHub App webhook. `--manifest` prints the manifest. No credentials are required to print it
- [doctor](https://github.com/CHAPIBUNNY/repolens/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md): `npx @chappibunny/repolens doctor` validates setup
- [mcp](https://github.com/CHAPIBUNNY/repolens/blob/main/docs/MCP.md): `npx -y @chappibunny/repolens mcp` starts the stdio server

## MCP

- [MCP.md](https://github.com/CHAPIBUNNY/repolens/blob/main/docs/MCP.md): client configs for Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code, and Cline
- Command: `npx -y @chappibunny/repolens mcp`
- Tools: `get_system_overview`, `list_modules`, `get_api_surface`, `get_dependency_graph`, `get_architecture_diff`, `generate_docs`
- Optional env `REPOLENS_WORKSPACE` points at a repository. Paths cannot leave that directory. `generate_docs` is the only tool that writes files.

## GitHub Action

- [Architecture comment](https://github.com/CHAPIBUNNY/repolens/blob/main/README.md): `command: comment` on `pull_request` posts one sticky comment (marker `<!-- repolens:architecture-diff -->`, edited in place)
- The comment lists modules, files, and dependencies that changed, the code-health delta, and new hotspots
- Footer text is "Generated by RepoLens" and links to the repository and the gallery
- Permission: `GITHUB_TOKEN` with `pull-requests: write` (checkout also needs `contents: read`). No personal access token
- Fork pull requests skip the comment and write the job summary instead
- [Badge](https://github.com/CHAPIBUNNY/repolens/blob/main/README.md): `command: badge` writes `repolens-badge.json` and `repolens-badge.svg`. Host the JSON on GitHub Pages and point shields.io at it
- `comment` and `badge` run from the action checkout, so they do not wait for an npm publish

## Gallery

- [RepoLens gallery](https://chapibunny.github.io/repolens/): one indexable page per curated repository, titled "<repo> architecture explained", plus a score page and a README badge
- [llms.txt on the site](https://chapibunny.github.io/repolens/llms.txt): this file with links to each explained page
- [llms-full.txt](https://chapibunny.github.io/repolens/llms-full.txt): longer description for assistants

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/CHAPIBUNNY/repolens/blob/main/llms-full.txt): install, CLI, MCP, action, and badge in one file
- [README](https://github.com/CHAPIBUNNY/repolens/blob/main/README.md): human landing page
